waray: Nabasa an anak nira Tita ngan hi Jojo.
en: Tita and Jojo's child is reading.
reason: 'ngan hi' in genitive coordination; expected nira Tita ngan ni Jojo
suggest: Nabasa an anak nira Tita ngan ni Jojo.

waray: Manan-aw an mga anak nira Ben ngan hi Pam hin sine ha Queens.
en: Ben and Pam's children will watch a movie at Queens.
reason: 'ngan hi' inside genitive coordination should be ngan (ni); mang- never taught, expected Matan-aw
suggest: Matan-aw an mga anak nira Ben ngan ni Pam hin sine ha Queens.

waray: Nagsimba hira hin mga diyos-diyos ha ira simbahan.
en: They worshiped idols at their church.
reason: L6b ma- lesson; book marks idols with ha not hin: 'Sinmimba ... ha mga diyos-diyos'
suggest: Sinmimba hira ha mga diyos-diyos ha ira simbahan.

waray: Uminom an iya lolo hin kapé.
en: His grandfather drank the coffee.
reason: past is inminom (-inm-); book glosses 'Uminom...' as 'will drink'
suggest: Inminom an iya lolo hin kapé.

waray: Sinmakat hira didto ha balay ni Luz.
en: They climbed up there at Luz's house.
reason: root should be saka (climb); Tramp sakát = 'cut flesh by mistake'; expected Sinmaka
suggest: Sinmaka hira didto ha balay ni Luz.

waray: Tinindog kami dinhi.
en: We stood here.
reason: past is -inm-: Tinmindog; 'Tinindog' drops m
suggest: Tinmindog kami dinhi.

waray: Hinigda an iyo mga anak ha katre ni Katrina.
en: Your (pl) children laid down on Katrina's bed.
reason: past should be Hinmigda (-inm-); 'Hinigda' is -in- form / progressive per Tramp
suggest: Hinmigda an iyo mga anak ha katre ni Katrina.

waray: Kinanta an uyab ni Lorie ha iya.
en: Lorie's boyfriend sang to her.
reason: book has Kinmanta; 'Kinanta' is -in- object focus vs AF meaning
suggest: Kinmanta an uyab ni Lorie ha iya.

waray: Mahugas hin bado an amon mga kabulig para ha iyo.
en: Our helpers will wash clothes for you (pl).
reason: book verb for laundering is labá; hugas=wash objects; also hin-object before an-subject inverts taught order
suggest: Malaba an amon mga kabulig hin bado para ha iyo.

waray: Nag-luto an iya nanay hin mga utanon didto ha kusina para ha mga karpintero.
en: His mother cooked vegetables there in the kitchen for the carpenters.
reason: L10 review predates nag-; luto is ma-class until L22; also nag- hyphenates only before vowels
suggest: Naluto an iya nanay hin mga utanon didto ha kusina para ha mga karpintero.

waray: Nahuram hi Bebing iton nga libro para ha iya mga estudyante.
en: Bebing is borrowing that book for her students.
reason: object of AF verb must be oblique 'hiton nga libro', not subject-form 'iton'
suggest: Nahuram hi Bebing hiton nga libro para ha iya mga estudyante.

waray: Nangkaon an mga bisita hin isda ngan prutas, ngan inminom hin gatas.
en: The visitors ate fish(pl) and fruit, and drank milk.
reason: 'nangkaon' fails nasal assimilation, form absent from Tramp/book; expected Kinmaon; also drops plural mga isda
suggest: Kinmaon an mga bisita hin mga isda ngan prutas, ngan inminom hin gatas.

waray: Babasa iton nga makugihon nga estudyante hini nga daku nga libro.
en: That industrious student will read this big book.
reason: bare CV-reduplication 'babasa' is Tagalog-style, not taught; expected mabasa
suggest: Mabasa iton nga makugihon nga estudyante hini nga daku nga libro.

waray: Binmatindog an bug-os nga singbahan, ngan binmasa han ira mga Biblia.
en: The whole church stood, and read their Bibles.
reason: 'binmatindog' implies root batindog (nonexistent); expected tinmindog
suggest: Tinmindog an bug-os nga singbahan, ngan binmasa han ira mga Biblia.

waray: hugakon nga pastor
en: lazy pastor
reason: 'hugakon' not in Tramp (hugak='loosen/relax'); book's lazy = hubya; expected hubya nga pastor
suggest: hubya nga pastor

waray: Espiritu ba iton nga maraot?
en: Is that "over there" an evil spirit?
reason: prompt says 'over there' = adto; also inverted pattern: expected 'Maraot ba adto nga espiritu?'
suggest: Maraot ba adto nga espiritu?

waray: Sinulod ka ba ha ira balay?
en: Did you(sing) go inside their house?
reason: past AF is Sinmulod; 'Sinulod' is -in- object-focus, never taught
suggest: Sinmulod ka ba ha ira balay?

waray: Maúli kamo na ba?
en: Are you(pl) going home now?
reason: full pronoun kamo must FOLLOW particles: 'Maúli na ba kamo?'; only enclitic ka precedes
suggest: Maúli na ba kamo?

waray: Napili na ba hi Emily hin magayon nga bado para ha iya kasal, o masul-ot pa ba hiya han imo?
en: Has Emily already chosen a beautiful dress for her wedding, or will she still wear yours?
reason: 'magayon' is Bikol, not in Tramp/book; expected mahusay
suggest: Napili na ba hi Emily hin mahusay nga bado para ha iya kasal, o masul-ot pa ba hiya han imo?

waray: Nasul-ot pa ba ikaw han pula nga bado?
en: Are you(sing) still wearing the red dress?
reason: ikaw has only short form ka postverbally, ka precedes particles: 'Nasul-ot ka pa ba...'
suggest: Nasul-ot ka pa ba han pula nga bado?

waray: Matámbong ka liwat ba han párte?
en: Will you(sing) also attend the party?
reason: 'ka liwat ba' inverts ba-before-liwat rule
suggest: Matámbong ka ba liwat han párte?

waray: Matúbyan ka liwat ba han Ginoo?
en: Will you(sing) also commit yourself to the Lord?
reason: 'ka liwat ba' order; han Ginoo vs ha/kan
suggest: Matúbyan ka ba liwat ha Ginoo?

waray: Matúbyan na liwat namon an amon mga anak han Ginoo.
en: We(excl) will now also commit our children to the Lord.
reason: genitive actor namon with an-patient = object-focus syntax on ma- AF form; recipient should be ha/kan
suggest: Matúbyan na liwat kami han amon mga anak ha Ginoo.

waray: Matúod liwat ba ini nga babaye?
en: Will this woman also believe?
reason: 'liwat ba' order + Matúod vs Matuo (believe)
suggest: Matuo ba liwat ini nga babaye?

waray: Nagpasaylo na liwat ba hi Eric kan Tina?
en: Did Eric already forgive Tina again?
reason: particle order: book allows only na/pa+ba+liwat, 'na liwat ba' unattested; also nag- pre-L20
suggest: Napasaylo na ba liwat hi Eric kan Tina?

waray: Nagsul-ot na liwat ba hi Erin han puti nga bado ngadto ha kasal?
en: Did Erin wear that white dress again to the wedding?
reason: 'na liwat ba' order unattested (book: na ba liwat); nag- for ma-class verb; drops 'that white dress' demonstrative
suggest: Sinmul-ot na ba liwat hi Erin hadto nga puti nga bado ngadto ha kasal?

waray: Tinúod liwat ba ini nga babaye?
en: Did this woman also believe?
reason: particle order 'liwat ba' unattested (ba liwat); verb: -túo believe vs tinúod adjective 'true'.
suggest: Natuod ba liwat ini nga babaye?

waray: Magtutdo ba liwat hi Pastor Tan?
en: Will Pastor Tan also preach?
reason: tutdo=teach but EN says preach; book verb wáli (Mawali)
suggest: Mawali ba liwat hi Pastor Tan?

waray: Nagkuráhab pa ba iton nga bata ha gab-i?
en: Does that (far) baby still scream at night?
reason: nag- completed vs habitual present EN 'does it still scream'; expected Nagkukuráhab
suggest: Nagkukuráhab pa ba iton nga bata ha gab-i?

waray: Binaya ba hi Berto ha iya pamilya?
en: Did Berto leave his family?
reason: bare -in- 'Binaya' is object-focus past; expected Nabaya/Binmaya
suggest: Nabaya ba hi Berto ha iya pamilya?

waray: Diri ko na liwat paliton hiton.
en: I will also not now buy it.
reason: paliton family
suggest: Diri na liwat ko mapalit hiton.

waray: Diri ko na paliton hiton.
en: I will not buy it now.
reason: paliton family + order 'Diri na ko'
suggest: Diri na ko mapalit hiton.

waray: Diri ko pa liwat paliton hiton.
en: I will also not yet buy it.
reason: paliton family + particle order
suggest: Diri pa liwat ko mapalit hiton.

waray: Diri ko pa paliton hiton.
en: I will not buy it yet.
reason: same paliton defect; also particle order 'Diri pa ko' per book
suggest: Diri pa ko mapalit hiton.

waray: Diri ko paliton hiton.
en: I will not buy it.(hiton)
reason: paliton object-focus never taught + clashes with oblique hiton; expected Diri ko mapalit hiton
suggest: Diri ko mapalit hiton.

waray: Nagpipiano hiya ha singbahan liwat.
en: She is playing the piano at the church again. [verbalized noun]
reason: sentence-final liwat unattested; expected after first full word
suggest: Nagpipiano liwat hiya ha singbahan.

waray: Nag-uukoy ako ha balay han akon suod nga sangkay.
en: I am living at the house of my close friend.
reason: 'suod' (close) not in Tramp, never in book — Cebuano import
suggest: Nag-uukoy ako ha balay han akon duok nga sangkay.

waray: Nagsarangbot hi Ronel kan Bing-bing ha simbahan, ngan yana magpapakasal hira.
en: Ronel met Bing-bing at church, and now they will marry.
reason: 'sarangbot' exists nowhere in Tramp/book; lesson verb is -kita (Nagkita); magpapakasal also off-vocab
suggest: Nagkita hira Ronel ngan Bing-bing ha simbahan, ngan yana mag-aasawa hira.

waray: Ayaw bantayi an akon awto.
en: Don't guard my car.
reason: -i imperative never taught; expected Ayaw pagbantay han akon awto
suggest: Ayaw pagbantay han akon awto.

waray: Ayaw pagtrabaho didto nga lugar.
en: Don't work at that place.
reason: 'didto nga lugar' malformed: didto is adverb, adnominal needs hadto/hito nga lugar or didto ha
suggest: Ayaw pagtrabaho hadto nga lugar.

waray: Ayaw rentahi iton nga balay didto yana.
en: Don't rent that house "over there" now.
reason: -i object-focus imperative never taught; exercise mandates Ayaw+pag-; course rent verb is -plite
suggest: Ayaw pagplite hiton nga balay didto yana.

waray: Magdadalagan ka pa ba ha bukid?
en: Will you still run to the mountain?
reason: book classes run as ma- verb (madagan/madalagan); mag- reduplicated future off-pattern
suggest: Madalagan ka pa ba ha bukid?

waray: Buot han bugto ni Ashley sumarig kan Jesus.
en: Ashley's sister wants to trust Jesus.
reason: buot requires I-Class subject (genitive only for kinahanglan/pwede/mahimo); 'sumarig' -um- never used with special verbs
suggest: Buot masarig an bugto ni Ashley kan Jesus.

waray: Mahimo ni Bit-bit magluto hin panihapon.
en: Bit-bit will be able to cook supper.
reason: buot/mahimo pattern: subject must be I-Class 'hi Bit-bit'; genitive ni leaves no subject — but check: book allows genitive with mahimo? ('Mahimo ni Reynaldo ito para ha akon' was passed as ok)
suggest: Mahimo hi Bit-bit magluto hin panihapon.
